title: Effect of antipsychotics and mood stabilisers on metabolism in bipolar disorder: a network meta-analysis of randomised-controlled trials.
authors: Kong L, Wang H, Yan N, Xu C, Chen Y, Zeng Y, Guo X, Lu J, Hu S.
figures: Flow diagram of the network meta-analysis . Published studies before February 15th, 2024 were searched using standardised strategy. In total, 5421 records were identified from the databases. After duplication movement and detailed screening according to the inclusion and exclusion criteria, 41 publications were eventually included in the network meta-analysis.
